texts.name: Sniff
texts.biography: 'Sniff' seems like a mocking nickname, but he's really proud of his sense of smell. That's also the reason why foes who try to track him often find themselves waylaid instead.

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Rat or Battle Rat for each level attained after 1st level.
specialty.tooltip: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Rats or Battle Rats
specialty.name: Rats

texts.name: Gnawy
texts.biography: Gnawy learned a lot from the pirates, he was not skilled in navigation, but people often see wererats on her ship. Perhaps they consider him the leader.

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Wererat or Wererat Rager for each level attained after 2nd level.
specialty.tooltip: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Wererat or Wererat Rager
specialty.name: Wererats
